r2_scope.title: Enforce canonical-English exclusion including whitespace-wrapped identity
r2_scope.accepted_observable_defect: Accepted storage constraints and production verification compare lower(locale) to 'en' without trimming for the English comparison, so whitespace-wrapped English identity can bypass the persistent non-English invariant.
r2_scope.required_invariant: Persistent ui_translations and ui_translation_bundles rows must reject canonical English identity after trimming/case-insensitive comparison, and repository-owned production verification must detect the same invalid state.
r2_scope.smallest_safe_change_boundary: Add one forward migration after 0010 that tightens only the two persistent storage locale constraints, mirror the same invariant in db/schema.ts, and align repository-owned production verification. Do not rewrite 0002.
accepted_non_goals: Do not silently delete existing invalid data as part of the audit fix.
Do not perform external migration rollout or production verification.
task_non_goals: Do not change translation runtime/provider/Queue behavior.
Do not create an implementation PR during this preflight.

evidence.finding: ui_translations_locale_check is btrim(locale) <> '' and lower(locale) <> 'en'; ' en ' passes.
Accepted SQL contains the same lower(locale) without trimming; no later migration corrects it.
ui_translation_bundles_locale_check is btrim(locale) <> '' and lower(locale) <> 'en'; ' en ' passes.
Accepted bundle CHECK contains the same lower(locale) without trimming; no later migration corrects it.
Persistent-English verifier selects rows with lower(locale) = 'en' in both tables; whitespace-wrapped English is missed.

test_state.historical_storage_test_role: Executes accepted 0002 in isolation and rejects exact en; it does not and should not retroactively assert the future 0011 invariant.

counter_evidence.fact: translation_tasks_target_locale_check already requires targetLocale = btrim(targetLocale), nonblank, and lower(targetLocale) <> 'en'.
counter_evidence.effect: Normal machine task identities cannot use whitespace-wrapped English.

counter_evidence.fact: persistentBundleLocale() rejects non-canonical or English bundle locales before normal store reads/writes.
counter_evidence.effect: Normal bundle-store API narrows reachability of the bad DB state.

counter_evidence.fact: Machine publication writes ui_translations/ui_translation_bundles using the validated task targetLocale.
counter_evidence.effect: Current machine publication is unlikely to create whitespace-wrapped English rows.

counter_evidence.fact: The generic store shown on current main is read-only and short-circuits exact locale === 'en'.
counter_evidence.effect: No current generic write method disproves the schema defect.

why_counter_evidence_does_not_disconfirm: The accepted PostgreSQL CHECK constraints themselves still admit the invalid identity.
The repository schema mirror still encodes the wrong persistent invariant.
The production verifier independently misses the same invalid identity.
Runtime guards cannot repair an already-applied PostgreSQL constraint and do not cover direct/manual/future persistent writes.
schema_change_reason: Changing only TypeScript runtime guards cannot alter the database constraint.
Changing only the verifier detects but does not prevent invalid persistent rows.
Accepted migration 0002 is immutable, so the database correction must be a new forward migration.

schema_constraint_corrections.non_goal: Do not broaden R2 into a new rule that every non-English persistent locale must equal btrim(locale).
